stem: Voltmarkt's webshop repeat purchase rate is 6% over one month and 23% over twelve months. Which window suits the question "Do our customers come back to buy electronics again?"

options.text: Either one, since the rate does not depend on the window's length
Twelve months, since one month is too short for most second purchases
One month, since a shorter window gives a more up-to-date picture
One month, since a longer window counts loyal customers twice
